other_conditions: The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
The applicant must be a student
The student must have passed 12th grade from a Government or Non‑Government college
The student must be enrolled in a Graduate or Graduate Diploma course
The student must be regularly admitted to a Technical or Paramedical course
The student must not have secured admission to a Government hostel
The student must be a tribal student pursuing higher education outside their hometown
Eligibility category noted in source: tribal
benefits_summary: Provides housing assistance to tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns where hostel accommodation is unavailable.
